objective: Determine whether auxiliary supervision of unaddressed-register persistence at the step-1 transition (requiring r0 to preserve operand a during S1 -> S2) eliminates the r0/r1 read asymmetry and restores canonical ALU input alignment in CyclicMGUPhase16Model.
hypothesis: HYPOTHESIS (not a proven cause): insufficient persistence supervision at step 1 may be the primary cause of the r0/r1 read asymmetry, because r0 receives zero direct gradient signal during the S1 -> S2 transition. This experiment tests whether intermediate persistence supervision helps.
scientific_distinction: The cyclic ALU is fixed and analytical. Any improvement from this intervention concerns the supervision of the learned read, write and gate networks around it; it is not evidence of learned arithmetic from data.

persistence_query_definition.state: S2 (post step-1 transition, instruction 'SET r1 b')
persistence_query_definition.register: r0 (unaddressed at step 1, written at step 0)
persistence_query_definition.readout: project(mlp_read([S2, e_r0])) using the existing shared mlp_read network
persistence_query_definition.target: a (the r0 value written at step 0)
persistence_query_definition.equivalence: u_persist_1 is computationally identical to the step-2 operand read u_a

target_definition.verification: matched Phase16RegisterTask.simulate_trace() on every allowed example

metric_definitions.c_read: mean of the per-role mean cosine(u_a, Phi(a)) and cosine(u_b, Phi(b)) at step 2
metric_definitions.s_context: unweighted mean over digits of the mean pairwise cosine similarity of same-integer step-2 operand reads pooled across roles and contexts
metric_definitions.c_alu: mean cosine of the raw cyclic_alu(u_a, u_b) tensor at step 2 with Phi((a+b)%10)
metric_definitions.c_dest: mean of the step-0/1/2 mean cosines of u_dest_post with Phi(y_destination_t)
metric_definitions.cosine_guard: denominator epsilon 1e-08; similarity 0.0 if either norm < 1e-07

protocol.checkpoint_selection: minimum validation total loss, ties by highest validation accuracy, then earliest update

protected_test_split.status: STRICTLY FIREWALLED — never loaded, constructed, evaluated, queried or logged

gate_assessment.description: Behavioral Pass with Canonical Alignment: Hypothesis H1 fully supported; behavioral generalization achieved with full canonical harmonic alignment across reads, context, and ALU output.
